summary: Responsive layout regression check on 8 Phase-B Staff dashboard pages (mobile 390px + desktop 1440px). All 8 pages now use the standardized wrapper `p-4 md:p-8 lg:p-10 max-w-7xl mx-auto` and render without body-level horizontal scroll. Login worked with admin@boulay.ci. No console errors on any page. All required responsive behaviors verified (chip wrap, KPI grid breakpoints, table overflow-x-auto, list/detail stacking, kanban single-col on mobile, tabs wrap). Legacy pages /staff/clients and /staff/reservations also render correctly (no regressions). ONE minor cosmetic clipping found on /staff/memberships mobile only (membership LI right-column content clipped by ~12px because MAIN's overflow-x-hidden silently hides the overflow). This is not a body-level scroll bug but a content visibility issue.

ui_bugs.issue: On mobile 390px, the membership LI cards have inner content (status badge + price column) that reaches scrollWidth=402px while the wrapper content area is only 358px. The badge label 'DEMANDÉ' and the '350 000 XOF' text on the right column are clipped by MAIN's `overflow-x-hidden` (no scrollbar visible to user but right edge text is cut). Root cause: inside the `<div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">`, the right `<div className="text-right">` container has no max-width nor flex shrink constraint, while the left `flex-1 min-w-0` correctly truncates. The CSS-grid parent (grid lg:grid-cols-5) on mobile (default 1-col) uses min-content track sizing which propagates the wide LI children up.
ui_bugs.priority: LOW (cosmetic — body does not horizontally scroll; clipped content readable except for last ~12px on far right)

rca of the issue: Memberships LI clipping: the inner row at StaffMemberships.jsx ~line 200 uses `<div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">` with a left `flex-1 min-w-0` and a right `<div className="text-right">` (no min-w-0, no flex-shrink, no max-w). The right column contains a status badge `<span className="inline-flex ... tracking-wider whitespace-nowrap">` plus a price line `<div className="... tabular-nums">`. These elements have intrinsic widths >100px. When the LI is in a CSS-grid track (`grid lg:grid-cols-5`) without explicit `grid-cols-1` for mobile, the track gets `minmax(auto, 1fr)` sizing which uses min-content from children — so the wide right column forces the LI to exceed the parent's 358px content area. The parent MAIN has `overflow-x-hidden` which silently clips it. Mitigation: add `min-w-0` to the LI's flex container OR `flex-shrink` to the right column OR explicit `grid-cols-1` on the grid for mobile, OR wrap the list in `overflow-x-auto`.
